title: Structural Claims, Engineer Review and Relocation Reimbursement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
## Claims manual: structural items and relocation

**Deductible.** Each approved structural item under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty carries the program's structural deductible, assessed on approval and linked to the claim item.

**Engineer review.** A structural finding the homeowner disputes is reviewed by an independent structural engineer at Calloway's cost where the program includes engineer review; the engineer's finding replaces the field finding.

**Relocation.** While a covered structural or systems repair makes the home uninhabitable, Calloway reimburses relocation at the program's nightly reimbursement for at most the program's maximum nights per claim item, and never more than the program's reimbursement cap per claim item. The nights already reimbursed on a claim item are the nights on every relocation reimbursement payout approved for that item, and they count toward its maximum. A relocation payout is the lesser of the nights reimbursed multiplied by the nightly reimbursement, and the reimbursement cap.

## Worked figures (hypothetical stays; program figures from the limits schedule)

| Program figures | Nights claimed on the item | Nights multiplied by nightly figure | Cap | Relocation payout |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 175.00 per night, 7 nights, cap USD 1500.00 | 6 | USD 1050.00 | USD 1500.00 | USD 1050.00 |
| USD 175.00 per night, 7 nights, cap USD 1500.00 | 7 | USD 1225.00 | USD 1500.00 | USD 1225.00 |
| USD 150.00 per night, 5 nights, cap USD 1000.00; 4 nights already reimbursed on the item | 1 more night at most | USD 150.00 | USD 1000.00 | USD 150.00 |

**Points of judgement.**
- The deductible attaches to each approved structural item and is assessed on the day of approval.
- Engineer review is at Calloway's cost and applies only where the program includes it; once given, the engineer's finding stands in place of the field finding.
- The relocation limits are counted per claim item, so a second claim item has its own nights and its own cap.
